title: P3 backlog cleanup: closure hoisting, test hygiene, doc improvements
description:
What: Resolve remaining open P3/P4 items before Phase 2 work begins.

Why: 9 issues remain after Phase 1 polish (KITH-acp). Two require actual code changes (KITH-kg2, KITH-v7t.9); seven are security-context or clarity doc comments that reduce maintenance burden and communicate design intent. These are small-but-real improvements that are worth doing cleanly before Phase 2 adds significant new surface area.

Items:
1. KITH-kg2 — Hoist insert_if_allowed closure out of loop in events.rs (P3 efficiency: redefines closure every loop iteration)
2. KITH-v7t.9 — config tests: Box::leak for env var keys unnecessary (P3 elegance: use a Vec to retain ownership instead)
3. KITH-626.8 — Inconsistent error message detail in whois() vs status() (P4 quality)
4. KITH-v7t.6 — KITH_BIND_ADDR not in Config, no security note (P4 security doc)
5. KITH-v7t.8 — KITH_BASE_URL prefix inconsistency unexplained (P4 clarity)
6. KITH-626.12 — status() validation logic needs clearer doc comment (P4 clarity)
7. KITH-626.15 — Null-byte check needs security context comment (P4 security doc)
8. KITH-626.19 — socket_path() test helper needs isolation comment (P4 clarity)
9. KITH-c5d — auth.rs: clarify fail-closed and async-safety comments (P4 security doc)

Outcome: Zero redefine-in-loop patterns, no Box::leak in tests, all security-boundary code has a comment explaining the invariant it enforces.
